title.en: An Act Extending the Provisions of the third Paragraph of Section Seven of Act Numbered Two thousand and Forty-One to the Justices of the Peace of Palawan, Mindoro. and Batanes.

text.en:
The provisions of the third paragraph of section seven of Act Numbered Two thousand and
forty-one, reading as follows: "In case there is no auxiliary justice of the peace to perform the duties of the
regular justice in the cases above mentioned, the judge of the district shall designate the nearest justice of the
peace of the province to act as justice of the peace in such municipality, town, or place, in which case the
justice of the peace so designated shall receive seventy-five per centum of the sum of his salary and that of the
justice of the peace whom he may substitute," are hereby made applicable to the justices of the peace of
Palawan, Mindoro, and Batanes.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
Enacted, February 2, 1916.
